scripts.dev: concurrently -n bff,web -c blue,green "npm run dev -w @dash/bff" "npm run dev -w @dash/web"
scripts.dev:mock: concurrently -n crm,bff,web -c magenta,blue,green "npm run mock-crm -w @dash/bff" "npm run dev -w @dash/bff" "npm run dev -w @dash/web"
scripts.build: npm run build -w @dash/web && npm run build -w @dash/bff
scripts.typecheck: npm run typecheck -w @dash/shared && npm run typecheck -w @dash/bff && npm run typecheck -w @dash/web
scripts.test: npm run test -w @dash/shared && npm run test -w @dash/bff && npm run test -w @dash/web
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run lint && npm test && npm run build
